title: Kyoto One: the record begins
paragraphs: The Consoles were found in Kyoto. The clues surrounding them point to an electrical engineer, but we have yet to establish who he was or where he went. For now, the devices are our starting point.

They are well preserved and quick to wake. Some of the worlds they reach lie beyond the familiar routes. Battery endurance and system responsiveness still need attention, but a change to the system could affect what remains inside it. Before making those changes, we need to understand what the Consoles have retained.

Fifty Kyoto One Consoles are available to claim as preorders at US$520 each. Each claim includes three separate shipments: an Initial Voyager Pack with a badge and welcome letter; a package of gadgets, widgets and small components; then the Console. Dispatch dates are not yet confirmed.

title: Read the housing before the signal
paragraphs: Before turning to the signal, look at the housing. The pale front panel sits inside a low, dark shell. Silver controls extend from the sides, crossed by orange guards. A circular display sits between two narrow screens, and the body slopes down towards the rear.

Follow the edge around the device and the orange line continues along the dark casing. At the rear, it traces the closed panel. The controls, panel edges and three-screen face give us a consistent way to identify this batch.

The next step is to record the condition of each Console against that common structure. Which details are shared, and which belong to an individual unit? Those differences need to be understood before the batch leaves our care.

title: A quick start is only the first observation
paragraphs: The Consoles wake quickly. What matters next is how they behave once they have been running for a while.

Battery endurance and system responsiveness are the two areas that need attention. We need to understand how the power holds up during use and whether the controls remain responsive over longer sessions. Those checks are still ahead; we do not have a measured runtime to publish.

The next engineering update will set out the test conditions and observations together. That will give us a baseline for deciding what needs to change, and a way to check whether each change has helped.

title: Preserve the route before changing the system
paragraphs: Before we change the system, we need to understand what it has retained. Can the same routes still be reached after an update? That question determines the order of the work.

Some routes are unfamiliar. We do not yet know whether another Console can reach the same places, or what information this batch relies on to find them. The first task is to document the existing state and establish a way to return to it.

Preservation is still ahead of us. Once there is a reliable baseline, we can compare each change against it: does the device run better, and does the same route remain accessible? Until then, we have reason to move carefully.

title: A figure is not an identification
paragraphs: Among the unresolved observations is a figure who may be connected to the Consoles' former owner. If that connection holds, the route could tell us something about where he went.

We cannot identify him yet. We also do not know whether the scene shows a person present there, a recording, or someone with a resemblance to the engineer. Each possibility calls for a different line of inquiry.

The next step is to return to the route and look for details that distinguish those possibilities. Can the figure be observed again? Does the scene change? Until we can answer those questions, his identity remains open.

title: Kyoto One opens for preorder claims
paragraphs: Fifty Kyoto One Consoles are available to claim as preorders at US$520 each. Each claim includes three separate shipments: an Initial Voyager Pack with a badge and welcome letter; a package of gadgets, widgets and small components; then the Console. Dispatch dates are not yet confirmed.
The second package is still taking shape. An antenna may be included, but its exact contents have not been finalized. We will record those details here as they are confirmed.
Earlier Initial Pack orders remain a separate delivery commitment. You do not need to claim Kyoto One to receive your earlier purchase.
